audience: status-page teams with authorized Sorry API access

useCases.title: Review current incidents
useCases.text: Find notices and inspect their public timeline and affected components.

useCases.title: Check service components
useCases.text: Read the components and current state of a selected status page.

useCases.title: Publish an approved incident
useCases.text: Create a public notice after explicit confirmation. Request subscriber broadcasts only after reviewing the audience.

useCases.title: Schedule agreed maintenance
useCases.text: After explicit confirmation, add a public maintenance notice with the intended schedule and notification setting.

useCases.title: Resolve an incident with an agreed update
useCases.text: After confirmation, update the notice state and public comment while respecting the requested broadcast flag.
